tools.name: tourcms_check_rate_limit
tools.description: Show how many GET and POST calls this channel can still make in the current hour (TourCMS allows 3000 of each per hour). Also confirms the channel ID and API key work. GET /api/rate_limit_status.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_show_channel
tools.description: Show this channel's details: name, website, and contact information. GET /c/channel/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_search_tours
tools.description: Search this channel's tours by keyword, distance, month, or location, with paging. Use it to list products or find one. GET /c/tours/search.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_list_tours
tools.description: List all tours of this channel without paging. Returns less data than search, so it suits exports. GET /c/tours/list.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_show_tour
tools.description: Show the full details of one tour: descriptions, rates, options, and images. GET /c/tour/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_show_tour_dates
tools.description: Show the dates, prices, and special offers of one tour. GET /c/tour/datesprices/datesndeals/search.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_check_tour_availability
tools.description: Check whether one tour has space on a date for a number of people per rate (rate IDs such as r1 come from Show Tour). GET /c/tour/datesprices/checkavail.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_list_departures
tools.description: List the departures of all tours for one date, for staff views such as a daily sheet. GET /c/tour/datesprices/dep/manage/overview.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_show_departure
tools.description: Show one departure of a tour: date, spaces, prices, and special offer. For staff, not for customers. GET /c/tour/datesprices/dep/manage/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_search_bookings
tools.description: Search this channel's bookings, for example active bookings or bookings made in a period. Contains customer data. GET /c/bookings/search.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_show_booking
tools.description: Show one booking with its components, customer, payments, and notes. Contains customer data. GET /c/booking/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_list_payments
tools.description: List the payments recorded in a period, for reconciliation. GET /c/booking/payment/list.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_add_booking_note
tools.description: Add a note to an existing booking of this channel, for example a customer request or an audit line. It does not change the booking. POST /c/booking/note/new.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_search_enquiries
tools.description: Search this channel's enquiries, for example enquiries made in a period. Contains customer data. GET /c/enquiries/search.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_show_customer
tools.description: Show one customer record: name, contact details, and address. Contains personal data. GET /c/customer/show.xml.

tools.name: tourcms_list_staff
tools.description: List the staff members who have logins on this channel. GET /c/staff/list.xml.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tourcms_check_rate_limit · Private data: tourcms_check_rate_limit, tourcms_show_channel, tourcms_show_customer · Public sink: tourcms_check_rate_limit, tourcms_add_booking_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tourcms_check_rate_limit · Private data: tourcms_check_rate_limit, tourcms_show_channel, tourcms_show_customer · Public sink: tourcms_check_rate_limit, tourcms_add_booking_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
